meta_description: Dubai hotels with a private pool from €429 to €3,259 a night compared: beach and Palm villas, a desert dome, city suites with plunge pools and budget picks.

lead: For most couples the private-pool stay to book in Dubai is Meliá Desert Palm at €481 a night (member price): a 198 m² villa with its own pool on a polo estate, 15 minutes from the airport. For a pool near the beach and nightlife, FIVE LUXE at JBR (€440) has the best guest score here; for a villa on the sand, Nikki Beach (€1,036, breakfast included); and the cheapest hotel suite with its own pool is Al Bandar Rotana on Dubai Creek at €429.

What most people miss: a private pool costs 2 to 5 times the same hotel's cheapest room, and the most space for your money is away from the beach. All 10 were compared on the price of the cheapest pool room or villa for the same night, guest and location score, pool type, unit size, beach and breakfast. Filter by beach, city, out-of-town, families or budget below, or jump to the comparison table.

items.title: Meliá Desert Palm, member of Meliá Collection

pills.body: Green lawns, horses and art from the owner's private collection, 20 minutes from Dubai Mall. Staff score 9.6 and cleanliness 9.5.

items.skip: if you want sand and sea: this is an inland estate, so book Nikki Beach (#4) or One&Only The Palm (#3) instead.

review: Meliá Desert Palm is the first private-pool stay to look at. For €481 a night (member price, free sign-in) you get a One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool of about 198 m² on a 160-acre polo estate, with a separate living room and a 9.3 guest score. Nothing else on this page gives you that much space and your own pool for under €500.

The estate is the point: a championship polo field, riding and polo lessons, tennis, a cycling track and the SAMĀNA Spa, whose water circuit includes an ice room, cold pool and heated stone beds. Dining runs from the Epicure brasserie and Pony bar to the Signature Steakhouse, and villa guests can book an in-villa BBQ with a personal chef.

Compared with FIVE LUXE (#2, €440), you pay €41 more for twice the floor space and a garden-estate setting, but lose the beach and the nightlife. Compared with Al Marmoom (#8), it is €356 cheaper and only 15 minutes from Dubai International, but it is a green estate, not the dunes.
The catches: there are no cots or extra beds, an AED 1,000 deposit is taken on arrival, and taxes and charges come on top of the nightly price.

pills.label: Very good breakfast
pills.body: Continental, full English, Asian and American breakfasts; French, American, Japanese and Mediterranean cooking later, plus a bar and coffee shop.

review: FIVE LUXE is the best value here if you want your pool in the middle of the action. The 1 Bedroom Skyline Suite with Pool is about 97 m² with a living room and kitchen, costs €440 a night, and came with free cancellation. The listing does not say whether the suite's pool is private, so confirm that with the hotel. The hotel scores 9.4 from 11,584 reviews and 9.6 for location, the highest of all ten.

You are on the Beach Walk at JBR, 1.2 km from Marina Beach, with the Marina's restaurants and bars around you. The hotel itself adds an infinity pool with a pool bar, a plunge pool, a hot tub, a spa and yoga classes, and breakfast that guests rate very good.

Against Al Bandar Rotana (#5, €429), you pay €11 more for a far better score and location. Against Meliá (#1), you get half the space and a pool the listing does not call private, but a city and beach base. The catches: the listed check-in window is 15:00–18:00, and an AED 1,000 deposit is taken on arrival. Taxes and charges are added to the price.

review: One&Only The Palm is the splurge. The Beachfront Junior Suite with Pool gives you about 120 m², a private pool and a sea-view balcony, and the €3,259 rate includes breakfast, waterpark access and free cancellation with nothing to pay upfront.

What the money buys beyond the pool is the setting and the food: a private sandy beach on the Palm, Andalusian architecture, gardens and three pools, with Yannick Alléno's two-Michelin-star STAY, 101 for seafood and ZEST for breakfast. Guests rate comfort 9.7, second only to Al Marmoom (#8) on this page.

It costs about three times Nikki Beach (#4), which also gives you a beach villa with a private pool and breakfast. Pick One&Only for the food, the quieter boutique feel and the Palm address; pick Nikki for value. Check-in age is 21, and taxes and charges are added. review: Nikki Beach is the beach villa to book if One&Only's price stops you. The One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool is about 118 m² with two bathrooms, and the €1,036 rate includes breakfast that guests rate exceptional.

The resort sits on Pearl Jumeira island with a 450 m private beach, free access to the Nikki Beach Club and outdoor pools, five restaurants and Nikki Spa, whose menu runs to ice baths and IV drips. It is 15 minutes from Dubai International and close to Downtown, which saves taxi time compared with the Palm.

Against One&Only (#3), you save €2,223 a night for a villa of almost the same size (118 m² against 120 m²) with two bathrooms, but trade Michelin dining and seclusion for a beach-club atmosphere. Against Jumeirah Beach Hotel (#7), it is €1,071 cheaper, but Jumeirah includes dinner, transfers and a butler. The price excludes a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 20 tourism fee per night.

review: Al Bandar Rotana is the cheapest way into a hotel suite with its own pool: €429 a night for the Suite with Private Pool, with creek and skyline views and 25% off food and drink in the hotel.

It suits a short break or a stopover: check-in is from 14:00, the airport is minutes away, and the five restaurants and bars (including Morgan's gastropub and Gusto Italian) all have terraces over Dubai Creek. Breakfast is €32 if your rate does not include it.

The trade-offs against FIVE LUXE (#2): you save €11 but lose the beach area, the higher score (8.6 against 9.4) and the Marina. Most rates here are non-refundable, an AED 500 deposit is taken on arrival, and a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 20 tourism fee are added.

review: Anantara Downtown is the pick if you want the pool in the city. The Anantara Royal Suite with Pool is a 235 m² top-floor suite with a study, dining room and kitchenette, and the living room opens onto a balcony with a private plunge pool. At €1,076 with free cancellation, it was 40% under the hotel's standard rate for the night.

You are in Business Bay, minutes from Dubai Mall, Burj Khalifa and DIFC, so the plunge pool is a place to cool off between the city's sights rather than a resort day. The hotel adds a heated rooftop pool with a pool bar, a spa and a breakfast rated fabulous.

Against FIVE LUXE (#2), you pay €636 more for more than twice the space and a Downtown address, but a balcony plunge pool rather than a pool to swim in. Taxes and charges come on top. For more city hotels with a view, see our best luxury hotels in Dubai.

review: Jumeirah Beach Hotel is the all-in option. The One Bedroom Al Bahar Villa with Private Pool (about 130 m²) costs €2,107, and that rate includes in-villa breakfast, dinner, afternoon tea, evening drinks and canapés, a butler, two-way airport transfers and daily Wild Wadi Water Park access, with free cancellation.

The price excludes a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and an AED 20 tourism fee. More family options in our Dubai beach resorts comparison.

review: Al Marmoom Dome is the desert answer to a private-pool villa. The Dome is about 62 m², with a terrace over the lake, a private entrance and a private pool with a view, and the €837 member rate (free sign-in) includes breakfast and free cancellation. Guests score it 9.4, with 9.8 for comfort and staff.

It is a small lodge in the Al Marmoom Oasis desert reserve, about 25 miles from the centre and 36 km from Al Maktoum International. Expect horse riding and lake views instead of malls, plus an outdoor fireplace and barbecue facilities. Families are well treated: no check-in age, free cots and free extra beds for ages 4–11.

Against Meliá Desert Palm (#1), you pay €356 more for a smaller unit but a true desert setting. Most people will do one or two nights here and the rest of the trip in the city; if you only want an evening in the dunes, compare our 10 desert safaris or the best desert resorts in Dubai.

guide.h2: Dubai Private-Pool Hotels Compared: Price, Score, Size and Beach
guide.html:
All ten prices are the cheapest room or villa sold with a pool at each property, for two adults on the same January weeknight, before taxes. Eight listings say the pool is private; FIVE LUXE's suite and Zabeel Saray's 'Pool access' villa do not, so confirm with those two before booking. Meliá's €481 and Al Marmoom's €837 are members' prices after a free sign-in. The column that changes the decision is space: the most room per euro is away from the beach. Meliá's villa costs about €2.40 per m², One&Only's beachfront suite about €27.

guide.h2: Which Dubai Hotel With a Private Pool Should You Book?
guide.html:
• Best all-round, couples: #1 Meliá Desert Palm, €481 member price. A 198 m² villa with its own pool, a top spa and polo fields, 15 minutes from the airport.
  • Pool plus city and beach life: #2 FIVE LUXE, €440, the best guest score (9.4) and location (9.6) here; ask the hotel to confirm the suite's pool is private.
  • Cheapest private pool: #5 Al Bandar Rotana, €429, or #9 Al Bandar Arjaan, €456 with breakfast and a kitchen.
  • Beach villa: #4 Nikki Beach, €1,036 with breakfast, or #3 One&Only The Palm, €3,259 for the ultimate splurge.
  • Families: #7 Jumeirah Beach Hotel, €2,107, with two meals, a butler, transfers and Wild Wadi included.
  • Groups of up to eight: #10 Zabeel Saray, €1,859, a four-bedroom, five-bed Palm villa with pool access (about €465 per bedroom; confirm the pool is private).
  • Downtown with a view: #6 Anantara Downtown, €1,076, a 235 m² top-floor suite with a balcony plunge pool.
  • A night in the desert: #8 Al Marmoom Dome, €837 member price, with breakfast and free cancellation.

Travelling as a couple and want no children around the pool? Compare our adults-only hotels in Dubai. For more beachfront resorts without the private-pool premium, see the best beach resorts in Dubai, and for all the island's resorts, our Palm Jumeirah hotels comparison.

guide.h2: Booking a Private Pool in Dubai: Pool Types, Areas and Extra Costs
guide.html:
Which kind of private pool

  • Villa pools (Meliá, Nikki Beach, Jumeirah Beach Hotel): a real pool outside a standalone villa, the most private option. Zabeel Saray's four-bedroom villa is listed as 'Pool access', so confirm a private pool with the resort.
  • Suite and apartment pools (One&Only, Al Bandar Rotana, Al Bandar Arjaan, and FIVE LUXE, whose listing names a pool but not a private one): a pool attached to a suite or apartment inside the hotel.
  • Plunge pools (Anantara Downtown): a small pool on a high-floor balcony, for cooling off with a view rather than swimming.
  • Desert dome pool (Al Marmoom): a pool on the deck of a dome lodge in the desert reserve.

Where to stay

  • Palm Jumeirah and Pearl Jumeira (One&Only, Zabeel Saray, Nikki Beach): private beaches and the priciest villas. Nikki Beach is the closest to the city, 15 minutes from Dubai International.
  • Umm Suqeim (Jumeirah Beach Hotel): beachfront, with Wild Wadi included on the villa rate.
  • JBR and Dubai Marina (FIVE LUXE): the best location score, restaurants on foot, Marina Beach 1.2 km.
  • Downtown and Business Bay (Anantara): minutes from Dubai Mall; Dubai International 18 km.
  • Dubai Creek (both Al Bandar properties): the cheapest pools, minutes from Dubai International.
  • Out of town (Meliá on Al Awir Road, Al Marmoom in the desert): space and quiet; plan on taxis or a car.

What costs extra

  • Taxes and fees: the prices above exclude taxes and charges. Where the rates break them down, a 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and a Dubai tourism fee of AED 20 per room per night are added.
  • Breakfast: included at One&Only, Nikki Beach, Jumeirah Beach Hotel (plus dinner), Al Marmoom, Al Bandar Arjaan and Zabeel Saray; €32 at Al Bandar Rotana.
  • Deposits: AED 1,000 at Meliá and FIVE LUXE, AED 500 at Al Bandar Rotana, taken by card on arrival and refunded after check-out.
  • Extra beds: from free (ages 4–11 at Al Marmoom, 4–5 at Nikki Beach) to AED 250 a night at One&Only and Zabeel Saray; none at Meliá.

When to go

These rates are for mid-January, when Dubai's winter weather makes an outdoor pool usable all day. For a special evening out from your villa, compare Dubai dinner cruises or see the Palm from above on one of the best helicopter tours in Dubai.

faqs.q: Which Dubai hotel has the best private pool?
faqs.a: For most couples, Meliá Desert Palm: its One-Bedroom Villa with Private Pool is about 198 m² for €481 a night at the member price (about €534 without signing in), with a 9.3 guest score. For a private pool on the beach, One&Only The Palm (€3,259, breakfast included) is the most luxurious and Nikki Beach (€1,036, breakfast included) the best value.

faqs.q: How much is a hotel room with a private pool in Dubai?
faqs.a: On a January weeknight for two adults, the cheapest private-pool unit at the ten hotels compared ran from €429 (Al Bandar Rotana's Suite with Private Pool) to €3,259 (One&Only The Palm's Beachfront Junior Suite with Pool). The median was about €940. A 10% service charge, 5% VAT, a 7% municipality fee and a Dubai tourism fee of AED 20 per night come on top.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest hotel with a private pool in Dubai?
faqs.a: Al Bandar Rotana on Dubai Creek, at €429 a night for a Suite with Private Pool, followed by Al Bandar Arjaan by Rotana (€456, breakfast included, One Bedroom Apartment with Private Pool). FIVE LUXE at JBR sells a Skyline Suite with Pool for €440, but its listing does not say the pool is private.

faqs.q: Which Dubai villas with a private pool are on the beach?
faqs.a: Nikki Beach Resort & Spa (450 m private beach), One&Only The Palm (private sandy beach), Jumeirah Beach Hotel (private beach area). Jumeirah Zabeel Saray has a private beach on the Palm, but its villa is listed as 'Pool access', not with a private pool. For more of the island's resorts, see our Palm Jumeirah hotels comparison.

faqs.q: Is there a desert hotel with a private pool near Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. Al Marmoom Dome Luxury Desert Experiential Stay in the Al Marmoom Oasis reserve has domes with a private pool, from €837 a night at the member price, with breakfast and free cancellation. More options in our best desert resorts in Dubai.

faqs.q: Which private-pool hotel in Dubai is best for families?
faqs.a: Jumeirah Beach Hotel: no minimum check-in age, free cots, a kids' club and daily Wild Wadi Water Park access on the Al Bahar Villa rate, which also includes breakfast, dinner and airport transfers (€2,107). For a bigger group, Jumeirah Zabeel Saray's four-bedroom villa costs €1,859 with breakfast (listed with pool access; confirm a private pool).

faqs.q: Do Dubai hotels with a private pool include breakfast?
faqs.a: Six of the ten do on the pool-unit rate: One&Only The Palm, Nikki Beach, Jumeirah Beach Hotel (breakfast and dinner), Al Marmoom Dome, Al Bandar Arjaan and Zabeel Saray. At Al Bandar Rotana breakfast costs €32.

methodology: We compared 18 Dubai properties that sell rooms or villas with a private pool, on live prices for the same night (two adults, one night in mid-January), and kept the 10 that give a genuinely different choice: Palm and beach villas, a desert dome, city suites with plunge pools and creekside budget options, from €429 to €3,259. Each was scored on the price of its cheapest private-pool unit, guest and location score, pool type and unit size, beach access, breakfast, child and pet policies, deposits and distances to the airport and city. Rankings reward the best all-round stay first, then the clearest pick for each type of traveller.
